fact: UNESCO's country profile states São Tomé and Príncipe has no AI-specific laws or regulations governing the development, use or deployment of AI (undated in the document, so as_of is its published date, 2026-01-22).

UNESCO's country profile states the country lacks AI-specific legislation, and that INIC guidelines and strategies do not carry the force of law (undated in the document, so as_of is its published date, 2026-01-22).

The UNESCO readiness assessment, in the preface by the Minister of Education, states that Sao Tome and Principe has no laws or regulations specific to the development, use and deployment of AI; the document gives no date for this statement, so its published date (2025) is used.
